arabic text:
HOJAE KHATM FATIMA ZAHRA KA INTEZAR
BAS EK BAAR, BAS EK BAAR, BAS EK BAAR, BAS EK
BAAR
AI WAQT KE HUSSAIN AB AJAO EK BAAR
HOJAE KHATM FATIMA ZAHRA KA INTEZAAR
english translation text:
May Fatima Zahra’s long
waiting finally end—
just once, just once, just once, just once.
O Husayn of our age, come now just once;
may Fatima Zahra’s waiting finally end.

arabic text:
JALWA KARE JAHAN ME IMAM E FALAK WIQAR
HOJAE PURA TEEN SO TERA KA AB SHUMAR
CHAMKE UFAQ PA TOOR KE PHIR NOOR E KIRDIGAR
SADYO KE BAAD KHATM HO MAULA KA INTEZAR
AE NIKAL KE PARDA E GHAIBAT SE ZULFIQAR
english translation text:
May the majestic Imam reveal himself to the world.
May the promised count of three hundred and thirteen be completed.
May the light of the Creator shine again upon the horizon like Sinai.
After centuries, may the Maula’s waiting end.
O Zulfiqar, emerge from behind the veil of occultation.

arabic text:
GHAIBAT KA PARDA UNKE UTHANE KE BAAD BHI
ILM O AMAL SE KHUD KO SAJANE KE BAAD BHI
MAULA KA SAATH DENA HAI AANE KE BAAD BHI
JAANA NAHI CHARAGH BUJHANE KE BAAD BHI
NAASIR HAI KON KON YE HONA HAI PHIR SHUMAR
english translation text:
Even after the veil of occultation is lifted,
even after adorning ourselves with knowledge and action,
we must still stand beside the Maula when he comes.
Do not leave after lighting the lamp.
Once again, it will be counted who truly supports him.

arabic text:
HAI MAQSAD E HAYAT YAHI KHAAS O AAM KA
ATKA HUA HAI SINE ME DAM IS GHULAM KA
PURA HO KHWAAB NUSRAT E SHAH E ANAAM KA
BAS EK BAR DEKH LU CHEHRA IMAM KA
SADYO SE HAI IMAM E ZAMANA KA INTEZAR
english translation text:
This is the purpose of every human life.
The breath of this servant is held within his chest.
May the dream of supporting the Master of creation be fulfilled.
Let me see the Imam’s face just once.
For centuries we have awaited the Imam of the Age.

arabic text:
BAS EK BAR DEEN E KHUDA KO BACHAIYE
BAS EK BAAR AMN O AMAN SATH LAAIYE
BAS EK BAAR PARDAE GHAIBAT UTHAIYE
DAADI KA ROZA KARTA HAI FARYAAD AAIYE
PHIR JANNATUL BAQII ME AAJAEGI BAHAAR
english translation text:
Come just once and protect the religion of God.
Come just once and bring peace and security.
Come just once and lift the veil of occultation.
Your grandmother’s shrine cries out: Come.
Then spring will return to Jannatul Baqi.

arabic text:
BABA AB APNE ZAKHM KO DHOTI NAHI HU ME
NOKE MIZHAN PE ASHQ PIROTI NAHI HU ME
DURRON SE KHAUF AATA HAI ROTI NAHI HU ME
RAATON KO NEEND AATI HAI SOTI NAHI HU ME
ZINDAAN SE SAKINA KO LEJAO EK BAAR
english translation text:
Father, I no longer wash my wounds.
I no longer string tears upon my eyelashes.
I fear the lashes; I do not even cry.
Sleep comes at night, but I cannot sleep.
Take Sakina from the prison just once.

arabic text:
BAZAR E SHAAM ME HAI MASAEB KI INTEHA
PHUPIYON KE SAR KHULE HAIN TO AABID KA SAR
JHUKA
HOJAEN TE YE SAATHWE DAR KA BHI MARHALA
NAMUSE MUSTAFA KO JO MIL JAE EK RIDA
REH JAE BAKI CHADAR E TATHEER KA WIQAAR
english translation text:
In the marketplace of Shaam,
suffering has reached its limit.
The aunts’ heads are uncovered, and Abid’s head is bowed.
May this seventh gate be the final stage.
If only the honour of Mustafa could receive one veil,
the dignity of the purified covering would remain intact.

arabic text:
DI PAR AMAL TAMEEZ HALAL O HARAM HO
JAZBA JIHAD E HAQ KA ZAMANE ME AAM HO
ISAR KA HAI SHAUQ TO PHIR AISA KAAM HO
BAS EK BAR LASHKAR E MEHDI MAI NAAM HO
PHIR ISKE BAAD MUSHKILE AE QAMAR HAZAAR
english translation text:
May people act upon the faith and distinguish lawful from unlawful.
May the spirit of striving for truth spread through the age.
If sacrifice is truly desired, then let the deed be this:
let my name be written once among Mahdi’s army.
After that, let a thousand hardships come, O Qamar.

arabic text: AEY IMAM E ZAMAN AAP KA MUNTAZIR HAI YEH JAHAN
english translation text: O Imam of the Age, this entire world awaits you.
